tasks.name: Staple three sheets into one document and file it
tasks.instruction: Gather three paper sheets into one pile, staple them once at a corner with the desktop stapler, and put the stapled document into the document tray.
steps: Gather the three paper sheets into one pile, until their edges meet on all four sides.
Put one corner of the pile into the mouth of the desktop stapler, and press the stapler until one staple goes through all three sheets. This comes after step 1.
Take the stapled document out of the stapler, and place the stapler in a zone different from where it started.
Put the stapled document into the document tray, until it is fully inside.
target: 3 paper sheets: one document, held together by one staple at a corner, fully inside the document tray.
Desktop stapler: closed, in a zone different from where it started.
tasks.free: Which corner is stapled, which side of the document faces up, the order the sheets are gathered, how the stapler is pressed.
qc: The three sheets come together into one pile with their edges meeting.
One staple goes through all three sheets at a corner.
The stapler ends in a new zone.
The stapled document is fully inside the tray.
tasks.pass: Target State seen, nothing fell off the bench.
tasks.fail: A sheet is not held by the staple; no staple, or a staple outside the paper; the document is outside the tray or over its edge; the stapler is in its start zone; the tray moved; an item fell off the bench.
tasks.realTools: A desktop stapler and plain A4 sheets, as used in every office. Not improvised. Not in the Asset Pool.
tasks.needs: Desktop stapler; staples; A4 paper sheets
tasks.usesUp: 3 A4 sheets and 1 staple per episode.
tasks.rigTest: The gripper can pick a single sheet off the bench, and can press the stapler hard enough for one staple to go through three sheets.

reverse.why: A staple cannot be taken out with the items on the bench. With a staple remover (Needs) the reset would be possible; until then each episode uses new sheets.

variation.start: Sheets loose in different zones, overlapping or apart, any side up; the stapler open or closed, any way round.
variation.doing: Slide the sheets together, lift one onto another, or tap the edges on the bench until they meet; bring the pile to the stapler or the stapler to the pile; press with one gripper or both.
variation.end: Any corner stapled, any side up, fully inside the tray.
variation.qcNever: Grip, the order the sheets are picked up, which corner, which side faces up.
variation.mistakes: A sheet missed by the staple; edges not meeting before stapling; the document left on the tray edge.
